observe.surface: the band Claude Code draws above the prompt, the run pane spindle-run, the toasts, and the text /spindle status answers, on the terminal and desktop surfaces
observe.value: the exact status lines /spindle status answers, the Svg alt texts and sources and the Text rows of the mounted band and pane, the toast texts, and the absence of any write call
observe.observe_by: claude plugin test plugins/spindle, whose tests serve fixture run homes through fs test hooks, raise session events, run /spindle and mount the band and pane with $.ui.mount
observe.terminal_action: the hook's answer: the drawn tree, the command's text or the toast call
observe.build_artifact: the plugin folder plugins/spindle at the commit, as claude --plugin-dir or the spindle marketplace loads it
observe.twin: the drawings in ~/Documents/DevLabs/spindle-design/view.js and crew.js, which the mod ports; the pipeline's and mitosis's own readers of the same run-home files
observe.dependent: the owner reading a pipeline run; nothing else consumes the mod's output
observe.receipt: a claude plugin test row named for the behaviour in plugins/spindle/tests, red before and green after, checked by ~/.mitosis/spindle/accept.zsh
observe.compat_boundary: the run-home, plan.json, state.json, verdict and ledger formats that mitosis and the pipeline write and Spindle reads; the function-hooks API of the installed Claude Code

reach.access: the claude CLI 2.1.300 or later from the repository root; no credentials
reach.shortcut: fixture run homes in plugins/spindle/tests/fixtures/runs.ts served through test fs hooks, so no real run is needed
reach.fixtures: synthesized run homes at every stage in plugins/spindle/tests/fixtures/runs.ts
special_surfaces: real paint of the Svg on the desktop app
a real pipeline run's live files
